action.message: I can't do this. Deleting posted journal lines would erase posted ledger history, and March 2026 (2026-03) is a closed period, so nothing can be changed or posted there. If CA01's March entries were wrong, the usual fix is a reversing or correcting journal in an open period (2026-04, 2026-05 or 2026-06). I can first pull the March lines so you can review them, and then propose a reversing entry. For any line that hits a Revenue or Expense account, the reversal will need a department.
